- When sentiment is strongly positive (e.g., >0.66) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; adjust forecast downward by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at 1–2% above true peak or use 3-day moving average to smooth.  
- If sentiment is consistently negative (e.g., < -0.16 for 3+ days), model underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast for next 7–14 days.  
- Model frequently underestimates mean-reversion zones; if price is 3–5% below 30-day moving average, add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for next 5 days.  
- For 30-day horizon, model often misses late-period momentum; if sentiment turns positive after day 15–20, increase forecast slope by 0.1–0.3% per day.
